sloka: तद्भग्नं वनषण्डं तु भ्रान्तत्रस्तमृगद्विजम् ।प्रतिबुद्धा निरीक्षन्ते राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः ।। ५.५८.१०९ ।।।।
transliteration: tadbhagnaṁ vanaṣaṇḍaṁ tu bhrāntatrastamṛgadvijam ।pratibuddhā nirīkṣante rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ ।। 5.58.109 ।।।।

translations.english: "Those uglyfaced ogresses woke up and saw the devastated garden and terrified beasts and birds.
